featured.title: From hand-sorted documents to 95% accurate claims classification in seconds
featured.summary: Sorting documents from many insurance providers by hand caused delays, errors, and lost files. Using Snowflake Cortex AI functions like AI_EXTRACT, Viewnear automated classification and extraction, lifting accuracy from 60% to 95% and cutting per-document handling to four seconds.

agentic.title: Installation scheduling from 17 hours a week to under two
agentic.summary: Getting install crews scheduled ran across five disconnected systems and cost 13 to 17 hours a week. Claude does the gathering through a connector into the system of record, and a full day of installs is signed off in about a minute.
